protocol.prewarm: One full240step process for each of the four path/order configurations, using a task-local copy of the existing pipeline cache. Snapshot resulting cache and copy identical bytes for every measured run.
protocol.pair_order: CPU-compatible1 then GPU-native0 on odd pairs; reverse on even pairs.
protocol.timing: physics_ms interval: b3World_Step + b3World_Wait (GPU queue completion and pose synchronization) + bounded counters before profile mark. Not pure shader time.
protocol.validation: Exact240observed/180measured steps, submitted/completed steps61..240, no in-flight work, correct dimensions and body/joint counts, no pause, no capacity loss, no fallback-order warnings, selected Vulkan NVIDIA adapter. Each task stops on first failure; no selective replacement or extra repeats.
protocol.analysis: Run arithmetic means, p95 and max; five paired log ratios log(GPU0/CPU1), geometric mean ratio, two-sided95% Student-t CI (df4,t=2.7764451052) and one-sided95% upper bound (t=2.1318467863). Speed improvement demonstrated only if upper bound<1; no default switch.
protocol.scope: Current mode comparison includes all existing opt-in policies, including paired normal solving for order0; not isolated sorting cost. Large scene only. No competing qualification/benchmark jobs.
protocol.validation_correction: Scheduling phase stays labelled stale after CCD. Require known same-step/topology capacity-safe metrics, truthful current label, state delta0/1 and consecutive snapshot_state=previous.current_state+1. Scoped to immutable input-free audited scenes and isolated Xvfb.
protocol.upstream_setup: box3d/shared/benchmarks.c CreateLargePyramid: baseCount100,5050dynamic unit cubes plus ground, density100, sleep disabled; preserve all other defaults.
